gold_sql:
WITH p1 AS (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-82.608284 35.498511)',4326)) AS elev
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-82.608284 35.498511)',4326))
  LIMIT 1
),
p2 AS (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-78.918865 39.651391)',4326)) AS elev
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-78.918865 39.651391)',4326))
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN p1.elev > p2.elev THEN 'North Carolina Arboretum, Asheville, NC'
    WHEN p2.elev > p1.elev THEN 'East End Park, Frostburg, MD'
    ELSE 'equal'
  END AS higher_poi,
  p1.elev AS poi1_elevation_m,
  p2.elev AS poi2_elevation_m
FROM p1, p2;

  SELECT 
    '[3]' AS id,
    ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-82.608284, 35.498511), 4326)::geography AS geom
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    '[4]' AS id,
    ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-78.918865, 39.651391), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
elevations AS (
  SELECT 
    p.id,
    ST_Value(
      r.rast,
      ST_Transform(p.geom::geometry, 4326)
    ) AS elevation
  FROM 
    points_of_interest p
  JOIN 
    public.dem_us r
  ON 
    ST_Intersects(
      r.rast,
      ST_Transform(p.geom::geometry, 4326)
    )
)
SELECT 
  CASE
    WHEN e1.elevation > e2.elevation THEN e1.id
    WHEN e2.elevation > e1.elevation THEN e2.id
    ELSE 'Equal'
  END AS higher_elevation
FROM 
  elevations e1
JOIN 
  elevations e2
ON 
  e1.id = '[3]' AND e2.id = '[4]';
